allot.subject: Scheme of Arrangement
allot.text: Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Allotment of shares pursuant to the Scheme of Arrangement between Sanghi Industries Limited and Ambuja Cements Limited and their respective shareholders

allot.subject: Amalgamation/Merger
allot.text: Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation for allotment of equity shares pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Adani Cementation Limited ( Transferor Company ) with Ambuja Cements Limited ( Transferee Company ).
